refresh_minutes.label: Refresh interval (minutes)
refresh_minutes.description: How often the usage API is queried.

command.label: Click command
command.description: Command run when the icon is clicked.

window.label: Limit window
window.description: Which usage window the bar shows.

show_prefix.label: Show 5h / 7d labels
show_prefix.description: Prefix each percentage with its window.

show_reset.label: Show time to reset
show_reset.description: Time left until the window resets.

ready_text.label: Text when no reset is pending
ready_text.description: Shown instead of a countdown when the window is not running.

show_tokens.label: Show tokens used
show_tokens.description: Tokens used in the window (input + output + cache creation, from local transcripts).

color_by_usage.label: Color by usage
color_by_usage.description: Switch to the warning / critical colors above the thresholds.

color.label: Text color
color.description: Color role or hex color for normal usage.

click_command.label: Click command
click_command.description: Shell command run on click. Empty = refresh now.

logo.label: Icon
logo.description: None, a built-in glyph, a bundled star, or your own image (see Custom logo path).

logo_path.label: Custom logo path
logo_path.description: SVG/PNG file used when Icon is "Custom". Empty = logo.svg in the plugin folder. ~ is allowed.

include_cache_read.label: Include cache reads
include_cache_read.description: Add tokens read from the prompt cache to the count. They are cheap but very numerous, so the number gets much larger.
